陆清韵根本不管两个女人之间的硝烟，抬脚就离开。

“陆先生，欢迎你随时来潜我哟！”时笙淡定的冲陆清韵喊了一句。

陆清韵步子顿了半秒，随后又如常的落下，几步消失在她们视线中。

没了陆清韵，唐妍也不在端着，“你是不是看上清韵哥哥的钱了？我告诉你，清韵哥哥是绝对不会看上你的，就你那家世，给清韵哥哥提鞋都不配。”

不等时笙说话，狠瞪了她一眼，唐妍就追着陆清韵走了。

时笙揉了揉眉心，刷反派好感度这种事，果然是费力不讨好。

时笙觉得今天她就不该出来浪，她上厕所回来，还没到包厢，就见她那间包厢那边围着不少人，吵吵嚷嚷的声音很大。

好不容挤进去，入眼的是一片狼藉，汤汤水水碎瓷器，溅得满地都是。

夏满坐在地上，单手捂着头，指缝间有鲜血流淌出来，一滴一滴的滴落在地上。

“小满，真是对不起，我不是故意的。”夏萱伸手要去扶夏满，脸上满是歉意，“我没想到你会没站稳，小满你都流血了，我带你去医院吧，都是我不好。”

夏满冷着脸打开她的手，声音低沉嘶哑，“夏萱，你演够了就滚。”

“嘿，这人怎么不知好歹？刚才我看是她一直推那个姑娘，谁知道自己没站稳，把自己摔了，这会儿还怪人家。”

“那不是夏萱吗？”

“夏萱是谁？”

“夏萱你都不知道，国民女神啊！！”

“天，竟然看到国民女神了，女神好温柔。那个女人是谁啊？竟然敢这么和女神说话，让女神这么委屈。”

四周的人对着夏满指指点点，表示愤怒的同时，又为看到女神激动。

幸好来这里吃饭的都是有身份的，不会做出出格的事。

“小满，都是我的错，你别闹脾气了好不好，我们先去医院，留疤就不好了。”夏萱一副好姐姐的派头，担忧又无措的看着夏满。

脸上的表情恰到好处，不愧是要跨入影后级别的人。

就在时笙准备过去的时候，唐隐从人群中进来，一把将夏满扶起来，挡住了外面的视线，面上没什么表情，眼神却是冷冰冰的，“夏小姐，你身为公众人物，是否该注意一下场合？这里是私人场所，你引起这么多人的注意，是什么意思？”

Lu Qingyun didn't care about the smoke between the two women and left.

"Mr. Lu, you are welcome to come and infiltrate me at any time!" Shi Sheng calmly shouted to Lu Qingyun.

Lu Qingyun paused for half a second, then fell back as usual, disappearing from their sight in a few steps.

Without Lu Qingyun, Tang Yan was no longer holding it, "Are you interested in Brother Qingyun's money? Let me tell you, Brother Qingyun will never be interested in you. With your family background, you are not worthy of carrying Brother Qingyun's shoes."

Before Shi Sheng could say anything, Tang Yan chased Lu Qingyun away after giving her a fierce look.

Shi Sheng rubbed his brows. It was indeed a thankless task to increase the villain's favorability.

Shi Sheng felt that she shouldn't hang out today. When she came back from going to the toilet, before she got to her box, she saw many people surrounding her box, making a lot of noise.

After finally squeezing in, what you see is a mess, with soup, water, broken porcelain, and splashes all over the floor.

Xia Man sat on the ground, covering his head with one hand. Blood flowed from between his fingers and fell on the ground drop by drop.

"Xiao Man, I'm so sorry. I didn't mean to do it." Xia Xuan reached out to help Xia Man, her face full of apologies, "I didn't expect you to lose your footing. Xiao Man, you are bleeding. I will take you to the hospital. It's all my fault."

Xia Man opened her hand with a cold face and said in a low and hoarse voice, "Xia Xuan, get out when you've had enough."

"Hey, why is this person so ungrateful? Just now I saw that she was pushing that girl. Who knew she didn't stand firm and fell herself? Now she's blaming others."

"Isn't that Xia Xuan?"

"Who is Xia Xuan?"

"Xia Xuan, you don't even know she is the national goddess!!"

"Oh my God, I actually saw the national goddess. The goddess is so gentle. Who is that woman? How dare you talk to the goddess like this and make her feel so wronged."

People around him pointed at Xia Man, expressing their anger and at the same time being excited to see the goddess.

Fortunately, the people who come here to eat are all of high status and will not do anything outrageous.

"Xiao Man, it's all my fault, please don't lose your temper, okay? Let's go to the hospital first. The scars won't be cured." Xia Xuan acted like a good sister, looking at Xia Man worriedly and at a loss.

The expression on his face is just right, and he is worthy of being a movie queen.

Just when Shi Sheng was about to go over, Tang Yin came in from the crowd, helped Xia Man up, and blocked the outside view. There was no expression on his face, but his eyes were cold, "Miss Xia, as a public figure, should you pay attention to the occasion? This is a private place. What does it mean that you have attracted so many people's attention?"
